items.description: The Klondike Gold Rush was the great Yukon gold boom that began in 1896. It drew thousands of prospectors north and turned Dawson City into a famous frontier town.
The Gulf of Georgia Cannery is a historic salmon cannery in Steveston, Richmond, British Columbia. It preserves the story of the west coast fishing industry.
The Esterhazy Flour Mill is a historic prairie mill in Saskatchewan built by Hungarian immigrants. It reflects the early grain economy and immigrant history of the region.
facts: One of the few surviving prairie mills

items.description: The Confederation Bridge links Prince Edward Island to mainland New Brunswick. Its long, curved span is one of Canada's best-known engineering projects.
The Gooderham Building is a historic wedge-shaped landmark in downtown Toronto. Its narrow footprint and red brick facade make it one of the city's most recognizable buildings.
The Angus L. Macdonald Bridge connects Halifax and Dartmouth across the harbour. It is a vital part of daily travel in the Halifax region.
The Edmonton Funicular is a glass elevator system that links downtown with the river valley. It gives easy access to views and paths above the North Saskatchewan River.
facts: Connects downtown to the river valley
Offers views of the North Saskatchewan River

items.description: Toronto Zoo is one of the largest zoos in Canada and home to thousands of animals. It focuses on conservation, education, and large habitat-style exhibits.
Calgary Zoo is a major city zoo on St. George's Island in Calgary. It is known for wildlife conservation work and popular themed habitats.
Granby Zoo is a major family destination in Quebec that combines a zoo, water park, and amusement attractions. It is one of the province's most popular outdoor leisure sites.
The Vancouver Aquarium is a major marine life centre in Stanley Park. It is known for conservation work, education, and rescue programs for sea animals.
facts: Focuses on marine research and rescue

items.description: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada is a major indoor aquarium in downtown Toronto near the CN Tower. Its underwater tunnel makes it one of the city's most popular attractions.
Saskatoon Forestry Farm Park & Zoo combines a historic park, gardens, and a small zoo. It is a popular place to see prairie animals and spend time outdoors.
